lessons.keep: Give different action categories different arrow structures while keeping one mascot.
try: For an agent tool, show Connect, one balance request and a returned balance in the same terminal panel.
Use circular arrows for synchronisation and straight arrows for transfer, then test whether viewers can name the two actions.

lessons.open: How does the integration request permission and report success or failure?
